camel_example: aliyun vod DescribeMediaDistribution --region cn-hangzhou --EndTime '2017-01-11T12:59:00Z' --StorageClass Standard --StartTime '2017-01-11T12:00:00Z' --Interval day
description_en: Queries the time-based distribution of audio and video media assets. The maximum time span between the start time and end time is six months
description_zh: 查询音视频媒资数据按时间分布。起止时间跨度最大6个月
kebab_example: aliyun vod describe-media-distribution --start-time 2017-01-11T12:00:00Z --end-time 2017-01-11T12:59:00Z --storage-class Standard --interval day --region cn-hangzhou
name: DescribeMediaDistribution

parameters.help_en: The start time of CreationTime. Format: yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ (UTC). The maximum time span between the start time and end time is six months
parameters.help_zh: CreationTime（创建时间）的开始时间。格式为：yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ（UTC 时间）。起止时间跨度最大6个月
parameters.name: start_time

parameters.help_en: The end time of CreationTime. The end time must be later than the start time. Format: yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ (UTC). The maximum time span between the start time and end time is six months
parameters.help_zh: CreationTime 的结束时间，需晚于开始时间。格式为：yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ（UTC 时间）。起止时间跨度最大6个月
parameters.name: end_time

parameters.help_en:
The storage class. Valid values:
Standard: standard storage.
IA: Infrequent Access.
Archive: Archive storage.
ColdArchive: Cold Archive storage.
SourceIA: Infrequent Access for source files.
SourceArchive: Archive storage for source files.
SourceColdArchive: Cold Archive storage for source files.
Changing: the media asset storage class is being changed.
SourceChanging: the source file storage class is being changed
parameters.help_zh:
分级存储类型：
Standard：标准存储
IA：低频访问
Archive：归档存储
ColdArchive：冷归档存储
SourceIA：源文件低频访问
SourceArchive：源文件归档存储
SourceColdArchive：源文件冷归档存储
Changing：媒资存储类型变更中
SourceChanging：源文件存储类型变更中
parameters.name: storage_class

parameters.help_en:
The statistical interval. Default value: day. Valid values:
hour: by hour. Statistics are collected based on the calendar hours within the specified time range.
day: by day. Statistics are collected based on the calendar days within the specified time range.
week: by week. Statistics are collected based on the calendar weeks within the specified time range.
month: by month. Statistics are collected based on the calendar months within the specified time range
parameters.help_zh:
统计间隔，默认值为天day。
hour：小时，按起止时间所在自然小时统计
day：天，按起止时间所在自然天统计
week：星期，按起止时间所在自然周统计
month：月，按起止时间所在自然月统计
parameters.name: interval

MediaDistributionList.description_en: The distribution list of audio and video media assets. Statistics are displayed based on the statistical period (calendar hour, day, week, or month) within the specified time range
MediaDistributionList.description_zh: 音/视频媒资分布列表。按照起止时间所在的自然小时、天、周、月等统计周期进行展示

items.description_en: The distribution of audio and video media assets. This parameter is not returned if no data is available
items.description_zh: 音/视频媒资分布。没有数据则不显示

Count.description_en: The number of media assets that match the specified time range within the statistical period
Count.description_zh: 在统计自然周期内，输入时间范围命中的媒资数量

EndTime.description_en: The end time (exclusive) of the statistical period. Format: yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ (UTC)
EndTime.description_zh: 统计结束时间（不包括）。格式为：yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ（UTC 时间）

StartTime.description_en: The start time (inclusive) of the statistical period. Format: yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ (UTC)
StartTime.description_zh: 统计起始时间（包括）。格式为：yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ（UTC 时间）

Total.description_en: The total number of audio and video media assets
